summary: Bounded read-only inspection completed without modifying project files or running verifier-owned checks. Project-local evidence identifies this as the private annunimas-human tenant (README.md:14-20). Its active-draft ingestion contract classifies human knowledge before reliance, keeps human content private by default, separates authority from status, and requires unresolved conflicts to become candidate/quarantine review tasks rather than guesses (docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:14-25,49-69,145-152). The implementation validates the vault path, scans Markdown without following symlinks, parses required frontmatter, records semantic memory metadata, and retains only wikilinks resolving to existing files (src/lib.rs:92-193). Target-local tests cover existing versus missing wikilinks and rejection of a missing vault path (tests/target_local.rs:27-63). Migration evidence confirms that live human vault data, runtime state, and ingestion ledgers were intentionally excluded from this private/local tenant copy (docs/migration-notes.md:3-10). Root-level and sibling-project authority sources are outside this bounded leaf and were not required or inspected.
